# Frozen DK v0.32 controls

Copied with LF line endings from DK commit
`b876fe4ed5c8963a0e8c19e18c829821c0686654` before implementation.
`manifest.json` pins every imported byte sequence. Historical `expected` files
are observations of v0.31.2 and must not be regenerated to fit new behavior.

The green release gate is `tests/test_guard_release.py`: family-premise refusal
with discharge (instead of a traceback), the 97-variable witness succeeds,
non-COUNT disposition fields refuse, COUNT coverage debt remains, D-E5-GAP
stays first, and history displays the omitted model supersession. Live controls
repeat both frozen boundary inputs three times and extend to 1024 variables.

No full campaign, fixture generation scripts, or original scratch outputs are
needed to run these controls.
